# WuWa VR

Play Wuthering Waves in VR on a PC headset. A free, unofficial mod built on
praydog's UEVR and community work.

<!-- status:start (generated by dev/build-site.cjs from dev/site-status.json) -->
**[Download the beta · 1 Oct 18:17 BST · game 3.7](https://github.com/ChronoHaxx/wuwa-vr/releases/tag/beta-2026-10-01-1817)** · [Website and player guide](https://chronohaxx.github.io/wuwa-vr/) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/ChronoHaxx/wuwa-vr/issues)

Far trees, props and lighting now match between the eyes, and the Resonators and team-screen reflections are back in place.
<!-- status:end -->

Extract **WuWa-VR-Launcher.zip** and open **WuWa VR Launcher.exe**; Python is
included. [Setup](docs/START-HERE.md) · [Xbox shortcuts](docs/CONTROLS.md) ·
[Comfort](docs/COMFORT.md) · [Problems](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) ·
[How it works](docs/UNDERSTANDING-WUWA-VR.md)

**Use at your own risk.** Unofficial injection can trigger anti-cheat or account
bans. Not affiliated with Kuro Games. [Risk notice](docs/RISK.md).

## Source

- [Native changes, Lua and translations](mod/): browsable files plus pinned patches;
  [rebuild instructions](mod/BUILD.md).
- [Launcher, recorder and test tools](launcher/dev/).
- Website: edit `docs/*.md`, `dev/site-status.json` or the templates in
  `dev/build-site.cjs`, then run `npm run build`. Merging to `main` publishes it.
  Translations: [dev/i18n](dev/i18n/README.md).

Fixes, forks and feedback are welcome under each component's terms. Credit the
[original authors](CREDITS.md). Our website and guides are MIT; the combined mod
is **not** blanket MIT. Please keep access free (a request, not an MIT condition).

[Optional Ko-fi support](https://ko-fi.com/chronohax): no obligation, paid access or
promised updates.
